title: sony/gobreaker
notes: gobreaker.NewCircuitBreaker[any](Settings{ReadyToTrip: ConsecutiveFailures >= threshold, Timeout: openMs, Interval: 0}) created for each operation (v2, the current major version) and Execute(fn) for each call; MaxRequests is left at its default. The outcome is told by a flag the function sets, not by ErrOpenState.
